name: Greedy Meshing with Vertex Pooling
aliases: Greedy Meshing with Vertex Pool Bucket System
definition: A greedy meshing algorithm applied to a voxel system that iterates over each surface orientation separately, assigning groups based on orientation and utilizing a vertex pool bucket system to manage memory and draw calls.
summary: Greedy Meshing with Vertex Pooling is a rendering optimization that aggregates voxel quads into shared memory buckets to reduce draw calls and driver overhead.
